evidence: ROUND 11 — ONE LINE, AND IT WAS A REGRESSION I INTRODUCED IN ROUND 10. Round 10 wrote the block-header check as TWO regexes — one spanning the header AND its optional trailing comment for the refusal test, a narrower one for the read — and then applied /\\d/ to the WHOLE rawValue. A digit anywhere in the COMMENT satisfied it, so `run: | # step 2 of 3` was REFUSED with a message stating it carries an explicit indentation indicator, which it does not: the header carries none, the body is one command, and the message is factually false about the input. Reproduced across four real comment shapes — '# step 2 of 3', '# 44 sequential checks', '# bun 1.3.10', '# see #106' — and it is LIVE rather than theoretical because this repo's own ci.yml comments are dense with numbers. This is the class this file names in its own words: a rule that fires on correct code with a wrong explanation is one someone deletes rather than obeys. PROVENANCE JUDGED AGAINST BOTH EARLIER TREES, AND IT MOVED THE SEVERITY: main fails those rows too but for an UNRELATED reason — it has no comment arm in the header pattern at all, so it misreads `| # note` as a plain scalar and reports a phantom `|` operator even with no digit present — while ROUND 9 (bff6bbe) read all four correctly. So this is a regression against round 9, not against main. FIXED BY CAPTURING THE HEADER and testing only the captured group, which also collapses the two patterns into ONE: two patterns for one question is exactly how they came to disagree here, and there is now a single place that decides whether a value is a block header. PINNED BOTH WAYS, which is the part that matters: `| # step 2 of 3` reads and reports its body's chain, and `|2 # step 2 of 3` is refused. A case pinning only the refusal is GREEN against the code that produced the defect, so the read half is the one carrying the proof. SECOND CHANGE — THE COUPLING NOW HAS A TEST. unguardedSteps()'s JSDoc justifies excluding a refused-`if:` step as 'NOT FAIL-OPEN … a refused if: is itself a BLOCKING finding from ciChainFindings()'. That is true and verified end to end, but it is discharged by a DIFFERENT function and nothing tested the join — an argument with no test is what this branch has spent ten rounds learning about. The new case fails if ciChainFindings()'s unparsed loop ever gains a SCOPE (narrowed to run:) or an EXEMPTION (an allowlist keyed on the refused value, on the step's run string, or on the finding text), and asserts end to end against the REAL ci.yml with the REAL allowlist that a quoted, weakened guard still blocks — with a control asserting the unmutated file is clean, so the injection is not satisfied by a file that is red anyway. It also records WHICH check goes red: the assertion named for the guard PASSES, because the step is excluded, and it is the refusal that blocks; on main it is the other way round, and that inversion is the reason the case exists. THIRD — ITEM 3, MY CALL: 'the guard is not a parameter' compared two NUMBERS with deepEqual (equality wearing the wrong name) and was silently coupled to 'no ci.yml step has a refused if:', because a refused step is excluded from the left count and not from the right; injecting one anywhere in the file turned it red for a reason unrelated to what it tests, which is exactly how it failed during this round's own injection run. Moved to a fixture the case owns, with assert.equal, so an edit to ci.yml cannot perturb it. THE FOUR STRUCTURE HOLES ARE UNTOUCHED, as instructed. IMPACT: ZERO — ci.yml carries 0 block scalars of any kind and 0 with an indentation digit; all 44 run: values byte-identical across main (7f7bddd), round 9 (bff6bbe), round 10 (77aa753) and here; 0 of 114 governed commands moved verdict against any of them; auditSuite output identical; unguardedSteps(CI) empty on all four. DEFEATER HUNT AGAINST THE NEW PREDICATE, aimed at the header/comment SEAM this fix creates: 13 targeted shapes (a digit in the comment under |, |-, |+ and >; a digit in header AND comment; a comment containing a pipe; a comment containing the literal text |2; no space before the comment; two spaces; a comment with no header; a colon in the comment; a tab between header and comment) — 9 agree, 2 correctly refused, 2 invalid YAML, 0 BYPASSES. Full corpus differential now 86 shapes: 34 agree, 41 loud refusals, 1 over-report (run: > joined literally, pre-existing and pinned as deliberate), 0 BYPASSES. NON-VACUITY BOTH DIRECTIONS throughout; every assertion is deepEqual on the whole findings array, never .some(); line numbers are derived and then asserted rather than pinned. TEN MUTATIONS, ALL TEN BITE: testing /\\d/ against the whole value again; dropping the digit test; dropping the comment arm; scoping the unparsed loop to run:; three separate allowlist-exemption shapes; reporting refusals only for run-bearing steps; unguardedSteps ignoring its guard argument; dropping the refused-if: exclusion. FLOOR: npm run check 43 of 43 passed, 0 failed, exit 0, sandbox armed; test:check-suite 59 pass 0 fail; check:ci-chains clean. RESIDUALS: run: > folded scalars joined literally (pre-existing, pinned); block scalars trim a trailing newline (pre-existing, and the better answer); the four enumerated structure holes (second job, 'run :', flow-mapping step, quoted key) confirmed still silent on all trees and deliberately NOT built; atwordstart-flag-duplicated-across-branches (P3) unchanged.
